comparison.objective: Hold a dustpan while using a brush to sweep five cubes into it without gripper contact on the cubes.
comparison.physical_skill: Bimanual receptacle stabilization and tool-mediated pushing/collection of multiple loose objects.
comparison.success_condition: All five cubes are in the dustpan, dustpan is held during sweeping, and grippers do not touch cubes. Numeric containment and final-stability details are missing.
comparison.reason: It shares bimanual tool use and collection, but tests bulk planar sweeping of pre-existing cubes. The candidate's defining ability is precise contact-loaded fracture at four recessed inserts, avoidance of coil damage, and recovery of newly freed millimetre-scale tangs.
